name: vimmite-v6

iso-help.description: Show ISO modes and options without building.

check.description: Run the existing source checks; optional argument selects one check.

build.description: Explicit ISO build; pass published/local and output/cache options.

preparation: ISO builds require Podman, Skopeo, disk space and interactive sudo for rootful Lorax; local mode also needs BlueBuild. Existing build options/output/cache paths are retained and builds may overwrite their selected ISO. Source check prerequisites are listed in CONTRIBUTING.md. No build, registry access or privilege elevation occurs on default invocation.
